description: Scan DEVKIT components theo batches (≤20 files/batch), spawn auditor agents, build ground truth findings index. v3.0 refactored: monolithic SKILL.md tách thành procedures/ (9 files lazy-load per phase) + templates/ (4 JSON schemas, CORE-031 compliance). Hỗ trợ focused scan (--skill=<name>) và delta scan (--since=<commit>). Criteria S1-S12 cho skills, A1-A6 cho agents, T1-T5 cho templates.

prerequisites.notes: Yêu cầu DEVKIT components tồn tại để scan

scope.description: Component scope. --skill=<name> = focused scan cho 1 skill, skip Wave 1/3/3.5/4

delta_scan.description: Chỉ scan files thay đổi từ commit. Lấy changed files qua git diff --name-only

component_alias.description: Alias format thay thế cho --agents/--skills/etc. --component=X có higher priority khi cả 2 formats được cung cấp

working.notes: Schema audit-index-v1. Phase 0 populates components.{agents,skills,templates,rules,hooks,references,scripts}[] + master_plan_components placeholders. Wave 4 fills master_plan_components.*
working.description: Master ground truth index của tất cả DEVKIT components scanned

working.notes: Schema audit-findings-v1. Mỗi batch (Wave 1-3) tạo 1 file. Tổng up to 13 files (5 agents + 2 skills + 2 templates + 1 rules + 1 hooks + 1 scripts + 1 focused).
working.description: Findings JSON files per component batch. Mỗi finding có: id, severity, category (functional|structural), criterion_group, issue, fix_type, fix_proposal, evidence

working.notes: Schema audit-findings-v1. Wave 3.5 Bash verify: syntax, shebang, path refs.
Schema audit-findings-v1. Up to 7 files (MP-1 → MP-7), optional — chỉ tạo khi thành phần Master Plan tồn tại.
Schema audit-findings-v1. Chỉ tạo khi --skill=<name> mode.
Schema audit-scan-result-v1. Phase 2 merges + dedups (2-tier) tất cả findings-*.json.
working.description: Aggregated scan results: merged findings, 2-tier dedup log, summary per severity

working.notes: Status tracking cho resume support. Updated sau mỗi POST-GATE phase/wave.
